name: Export
description: Exporters that turn a scene into other formats: one frame as an SVG document, a scene as a Lottie JSON document with animated position, scale, rotation and opacity, and gradient stop alpha, and the frame plan (numbers, times, pixel sizes, file names) for a numbered PNG sequence. Output is byte-stable and throws on non-finite values. W1 writers fill one seam file each: SVGExporter+Style (paint at the frame), SVGExporter+Text (each text shape as one <text>, laid out over the metrics the caller measures, FixedAdvances by default: runs as tspans with their font properties, lines at their layout baselines, alignment as text-anchor, justified lines as one x per Unicode scalar, each element on one line), SVGExporter+TextPath (type on a path as a textPath naming its path in defs, startOffset as a percentage, a flipped path written reversed), SVGExporter+Masks (layer masks as a clipPath and a luminance mask with feather as a Gaussian blur, track mattes as a mask holding the source layer; difference masks throw) and LottieExporter+Masks (masksProperties with mode, inv, o and x, track mattes as tt on the matted layer and td on its source directly above; feathered masks throw, since Lottie masks have no feather), LottieExporter+Tracks (animated properties, including colour, width and shape keys).
